mechanics.claim: Killing any unit refreshes the standard buff's duration on subsequent kills.
Varus cannot gain the standard (non-empowered) bonuses while the empowered version from a champion takedown is active.
mechanics.quote: Varus cannot gain the standard bonuses while Living Vengeance is empowered.

mechanics.claim: A champion takedown grants the empowered version, refreshing an already-active standard buff into the empowered one for the same duration.
mechanics.quote: If the buff was active at the time of the empowerment (from scoring a champion takedown), the duration is refreshed while overriding the standard bonuses with the empowered ones.

mechanics.claim: Only further champion takedowns can refresh the empowered buff's duration, not non-champion kills.
mechanics.quote: ''Living Vengeance's'' empowerment may only be refreshed by subsequent champion takedowns.

mechanics.claim: Killing a non-champion unit while empowered causes the standard buff to be granted again once the empowerment expires, for a duration reduced by the empowered buff's remaining time at the moment of that kill.
mechanics.quote: he is special cased to gain the buff again after the empowerment expires with the standard bonuses. The re-granted buff lasts for {{pp|5 to 11 for 4|1 to 16}} seconds minus the remaining duration of the empowered version at the time of the last non-champion unit he killed.
